T: Clowns in the drain. Dessert on the table.
D: A group of misfit kids in a small Maine town face a shape-shifting clown that preys on children.
P: Serve the snacks when Pennywise asks Georgie about popcorn.
S: corn chips with spiced mince, melted cheddar, black beans, pico de gallo, guacamole and sour cream

Corn chips piled into paper boats with spiced beef mince, melted cheddar, black beans, pico de gallo, guacamole and sour cream, eaten with your fingers. Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, 2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tbsp tomato paste, add 100ml water and simmer 10 minutes. Layer 300g corn chips on a tray with the beef, 1 drained tin black beans and 200g grated cheddar and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Dice 2 tomatoes with red onion and coriander. Scoop into paper boats and top with guacamole, pico and sour cream.
Long soft rolls dressed with oregano vinaigrette and layered Italian style

Long soft rolls stacked with salami, ham, provolone, shredded lettuce, tomato and pickled peppers, dressed with oregano vinaigrette and wrapped tight for the bike ride. Whisk 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt and pepper. Split 4 long soft rolls and drizzle the insides with half the dressing. Layer each with 3 slices provolone, 4 slices salami and 3 slices leg ham. Top with shredded iceberg, sliced tomato, red onion and pickled peppers, drizzle with the rest of the dressing and close. Wrap each tightly in baking paper and halve.
Red balloon roast tomato ricotta toast
Whipped ricotta and roast tomatoes on sourdough, red as the balloon
Cherry tomatoes on the vine roasted at 200C for 10 minutes with olive oil and thyme, served on whipped ricotta with toasted bread.
M: two smashed patties, cheese, pickles and tangy sauce, crinkle-cut chips, beep beep Richie

Two thin smashed beef patties with melted cheese, pickles, onion and a tangy burger sauce in a toasted soft bun, with crinkle-cut chips. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles for the sauce. Bake 800g frozen crinkle-cut chips at 220C for 25 minutes. Heat a heavy pan until smoking, smash the balls thin, salt and cook 2 minutes, flip, top with cheese slices and cook 1 minute. Toast 4 buns, spread with sauce, and stack two patties with pickles and finely diced onion.
Lobster or prawn salad with mayo, celery and chives in a buttered toasted bun
Cooked lobster or prawn meat chopped and folded with a little mayo, lemon juice, celery and chives, piled into soft rolls toasted in butter on the cut sides.
W: Vanilla cake and cream cheese balls on sticks, dipped in red candy coating
Vanilla cake crumbled into cream cheese frosting, rolled into balls, chilled, dipped in red candy melts on sticks, tied with a bit of string.
K: Strawberry and lemon, served cold. Not gray water, Eddie.

Fresh lemon juice and strawberry syrup topped with icy soda water, served in a big jug with sliced strawberries, lemon wheels and mint. Simmer 250g hulled strawberries with 150g caster sugar and 150ml water for 5 minutes, crush and strain to a syrup, then cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a jug, add the syrup and stir. Add plenty of ice, sliced strawberries and lemon wheels, then top with 1 litre chilled soda water and a few mint leaves.
